description: Test suite for browser code execution and tool interaction, verifying behaviors like code execution, restrictions, and responses within a testing framework.

methods.name: browser_run_code
methods.description: Test case that verifies running custom code in a browser context and capturing console logs.

methods.name: browser_run_code block
methods.description: Test that runs multiple code blocks sequentially and checks output and logs.

methods.name: browser_run_code no-require
methods.description: Test to ensure require is not available in the browser environment and results in an error.

methods.name: browser_run_code blocks fetch of file:// URLs by default
methods.description: Test that fetch requests to file URLs are blocked by default in the browser.

methods.name: browser_run_code restricts setInputFiles to roots by default
methods.description: Test that file inputs outside allowed roots are denied when setting input files.

methods.name: browser_run_code return value
methods.description: Test that the return value of the executed code is correctly captured and returned.

ctags.name: code
